svg.title: Build rhythm: when I actually commit
svg.desc: A 24-hour clock in India Standard Time with one bar per hour, sized by how many of 381 commits from the last 12 months were made in that hour; a hand sweeps round and lights each bar. Busiest hour 17:00 to 18:00, 22% of commits between 20:00 and 04:00, busiest weekday Monday. Chronotype: daytime builder. Source: GitHub API.
svg.text: bar length = commits in that hour (IST)
updated 2026-10-27 · source: GitHub API · last 12 months
